head: Daypond: focus timer and breathing beside a koi pond
dek: Daypond has a 1-60 minute focus timer, breathing sessions and wind-down sessions next to an illustrated koi pond, with seven- and thirty-day charts. It was #23 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on 4 November.
details: A widget opens a one-minute breathing session. It costs $0.99, by Codesigner Tech.
means: If you want a calm timer for focus or breathing, it's a small one-time purchase.
todo: Find Daypond in the App Store.
